# Selected Projects

## Phantom — Bacteriophage Analysis Workflow

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/your-username/phantom)

- Modular Snakemake pipeline for phage genome annotation and downstream comparative analysis.
- Uses isolated Conda environments and declarative workflow rules to make runs reproducible across systems.
- Produces organized intermediate files, results, logs, and publication-oriented visualizations.

## Phage Visualization Tools

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/your-username)

- Developed R and Python utilities for post-annotation exploration of bacteriophage genomes.
- Designed figures and tables to help interpret gene content, genome architecture, and comparative results.

## Self-Hosted Research Infrastructure

[Project documentation](https://your-site.example/projects)

- Built a Linux-based environment for code hosting, containers, services, and research project organization.
- Applied infrastructure-as-code and documentation practices to reduce configuration drift.
